name: Klein Constantia
note: Historic wine estate (founded 1685) in Constantia, Cape Town. Own history page: 'In May 2011, the estate is acquired by Zdenek Bakala and Charles Harman, visionary businessmen'; the Stellenbosch property Anwilka of Hubert de Boüard and Bruno Prats was merged into it a year later. The 2025 section of the same page says the estate is 'under their stewardship'.
